visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A light blue Volvo EX30 electric SUV drives smoothly across a pristine white, minimalist environment. The camera tracks its side profile, highlighting the clean lines and modern wheel design. The car eventually stops, and the scene cuts to the next phase. (2) A young man wearing a black baseball cap and a white puffer vest stands outdoors in an urban setting. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and active hand gestures, introducing the car. The background shows trees and modern architecture. (3) Inside the car, the camera focuses on the large vertical touchscreen displaying a navigation map. The man's hand enters the frame to interact with the screen. The interior lighting is bright, emphasizing the minimalist dashboard and the Harman Kardon soundbar integrated near the windshield. (4) The shot transitions to the driver's perspective. The man's hands are seen gripping a unique, squarish steering wheel while driving. The road ahead is visible through the windshield, showing a paved highway with lush green mountains in the distance under a bright sky. (5) The man demonstrates the rear passenger space, sitting in the back seat. He uses his hands to point out the legroom and the texture of the seat materials. He then returns to the front, concluding the review with a final address to the camera outdoors.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這台就是 EX 30. [Logo]: Volvo EX30 小即大作. (2) [Subtitle]: 這算是 Volvo 第一次引進全新世代的電車. (3) [Subtitle]: 這次總共出了四款新的顏色. (4) [Subtitle]: 這台尺寸呢又剛好很適合女生. (5) [Subtitle]: 它把所有 Volvo 新科技的精華都濃縮在這台車裡! (6) [Subtitle]: 那我剛一進來呢我覺得最體感最明顯的就是這個椅子! (7) [Subtitle]: 很有科技感哎. (8) [Subtitle]: 就是這種駕駛艙. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後它的方向盤呢也不是傳統的圓幅哦. (10) [Subtitle]: 它是有一點點方形的感覺. (11) [Subtitle]: 它沒有任何的儀表板在這邊. (12) [Subtitle]: 它全部都結合到這個電腦裡面去了. (13) [Subtitle]: 所有的功能全部都集中在這裡面. (14) [Subtitle]: 喜歡聽歌嗎? (15) [Subtitle]: 第一次在車系裡面擁有聲霸! (16) [Subtitle]: 它的官方啊是說 100% 的話是可以跑到 450 公里. (17) [Subtitle]: 這種都會穿梭型的話其實是 OK 的. (18) [Subtitle]: 接下來我們來體驗一下後座的尺寸. (19) [Subtitle]: 後座大小到底會不會很擁擠呢? (20) [Subtitle]: 先給大家看一下. (21) [Subtitle]: 它前面皮革縫紉的地方是在外面那一層. (22) [Subtitle]: 但其實它裡面是可以內縮進去的. (23) [Subtitle]: 雖然我會頂到前面, 可是我至少還有一點往前伸的距離. (24) [Subtitle]: 今天體驗下來的一些優點還有缺點. (25) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這台車還是很不錯的哦! (26) [Subtitle]: 首先呢當然還是它的安全性. (27) [Subtitle]: 因為它的剛性非常好. (28) [Subtitle]: 也會讓你在操駕上面覺得非常安心. (29) [Subtitle]: 優點就是它車身很小巧. (30) [Subtitle]: 城市操控是非常 OK 的. (31) [Subtitle]: 那缺點當然就是它的後座還是比較緊湊. (32) [Subtitle]: 再來是它性能部分, 我覺得今天操控起來真的其實是有駕馭的感受的. (33) [Subtitle]: 再來是它 PA2. (34) [Subtitle]: 算是真的蠻成熟的產品而且蠻穩定的. (35) [Subtitle]: 我覺得它應該會賣得非常的好. (36) [Subtitle]: 好了以上就是我今天體驗下來一些小小的心得還有感受.

The reviewer's voice remains at a consistent conversational loudness, projecting confidence and enthusiasm. Transition SFX like soft whooshes punctuate the cuts. The reviewer's voice exhibits minor resonance changes typical of a car interior. The BGM persists, maintaining a positive and informative vibe throughout the feature tour. (4) In the final segment, the voice takes on a summarizing tone, slightly slower in rate but remaining assertive and friendly. The BGM maintains its energy before concluding as the reviewer finishes his final remarks. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high throughout, ensuring clear delivery of the product review.
